description: This file defines the SubpanelQuickCreate class, which manages the creation of a quick create form within a subpanel in SuiteCRM. It handles loading view definitions, setting up the edit view, and conditionally displaying the form based on module and view parameters.

classes.name: SubpanelQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that facilitates quick create forms within subpanels of SuiteCRM, managing view setup, data retrieval, and rendering logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the quick create view, loads view definitions, sets up the edit view, and potentially displays the form.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles processing the form display, including handling target actions.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the EditView class.

methods.name: getModuleViewDefsSourceFile
methods.description: Determines the appropriate view definitions source file based on module and view type.
